# 2015 RECYCLE RUSH – hindsight

Source: user hindsight notes, batch 1 (2026-09-27).

## Game play / meta
- The game was decided mainly by **who stole the cans first in AUTO**: the alliance with the fastest two robots to
  grab cans had a significant advantage.
- There was no alliance-to-alliance contact, so it is considered a niche, unlikeable game (no bumpers, and robots were
  allowed to be tethered – some used that to their advantage).

## Dominant robots
- **118 / 1678** – the overall best: solid at collecting and stacking, and the best at stealing cans with their rods.
- **2826** – the best TELEOP robot. In AUTO it did the auto bonus totes while collecting and stacking 3 cans on itself
  to use in TELEOP (the only robot that did it); it used them for its TELEOP stacks.
- **1114 / 254** – effective ground intakes.

## Effective mechanisms
- **1114** – the best intake mechanism that year for collecting and straightening totes.
- **3339** – actively tilting elevator, to shift the centre of gravity of a stack of totes.
- **118 / 1678** can-grabber rods.

## Niche tethering solutions
- **254** – tethered ramp to the feeder.
- **148** – two tethered robots: one stacking at the feeder constantly, the other coming to grab and score those stacks.
